changes: Single consecutive-wave interface; old interface removed from navigation
Automatic probabilities for all supported horizons; no horizon selector
Fixed radio options in place of editable/searchable dropdowns
Direct nullable recency entry; no hidden unanswered mode
Live completion; specific validation; stale results cleared on input edits
Responsive styling, cumulative probability cards and charts, factor explanations
Deploy/top toolbar disabled in configuration and CSS
validation_scope: Actual Streamlit AppTest interactions and source breakpoint/config checks. No interactive browser viewport or production hosting validation claimed.
restart_required: Restart the existing Streamlit server once to load toolbar and watcher configuration.
available_answer_policy: Missing inputs use trained missing handling; known unsupported profiles show a labeled hypothetical adult former-smoker scenario; a blank submission uses the fitted no-input baseline. No claim of expanded validated population.
reliability_policy: Limited evidence label; usable-input completeness percentage is not confidence. Group held-out metrics and available group bootstrap ROC-AUC interval shown. Personal confidence percentage is null/unvalidated. Baseline reference uses baseline metrics.
